id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

currentState.description: A stored calc field representing the current state - uses a {@link StateMachineHistory} to keep track.

stateHistories.description: A collection of the states this {@link StateMachine} has passed through.

transitions.description: Transitions available from the current state

currentStateHistory.description: Calc field to get the current state history

parent.description: The parent {@link ProtectionLoop} this alert is on. TODO: REL-4645 remove field once dataAlerting migrated.

timestamp.description: The time the alert was triggered. TODO: REL-4645 remove field once dataAlerting migrated.

unhealthySensors.description:
Unhealthy sensors in the protection loop.
{@link ProtectionLoop}

healthStatus.description: The evaluation of protection loop health which led to this alert.

triggerValue.description: The trigger value that made this alert. TODO: REL-4645 remove field once dataAlerting migrated.

title: Type that is created when a percentage of sensors fails and belongs to the same {@link ProtectionLoop} type.
name: ProtectionLoopAlert
